_about: John Hooper (d. 1555), Bishop of Gloucester and Worcester. Named john-hooper, not hooper, so another Hooper cannot collide. The target is the Parker Society edition (2 vols, Cambridge 1843 and 1852; ed. Samuel Carr, then Charles Nevinson), Internet Archive OCR, raw; each title page read. The Early Writings come from an Allen County scan because Toronto's copy returned HTTP 500 on its text file three times on 2026-10-03. No CCEL or Gutenberg Hooper exists.

hooper-ps-early: Early Writings of John Hooper, ed. Samuel Carr (Parker Society, Cambridge, 1843)
hooper-ps-later: Later Writings of Bishop Hooper, with his Letters, ed. Charles Nevinson (Parker Society, Cambridge, 1852)
